description.zh:
病种名称。
取值：
**CalcBMD** - 骨质疏松筛查,
**MuscleFat** -肌肉脂肪分析,
**DetectLiverSteatosis**-脂肪肝筛查,
**PredictCVD**-心血管不良事件风险评估
description.en:
Disease category name.  
Valid values:  
**CalcBMD** – osteoporosis screening,  
**MuscleFat** – muscle-fat analysis,  
**DetectLiverSteatosis** – fatty liver screening,  
**PredictCVD** – cardiovascular adverse event risk assessment.

description.zh: 可选，默认值pdf，当前仅支持pdf格式。
description.en: Optional. Default value: pdf. Only pdf format is currently supported.

description.en: Template Version number for the graphical report. Valid value: 1

description.en: Subject of the graphical report. Valid values: dark – dark theme, light – light theme
